## `src/backend.rs`

### enum `Runtime`

Which of the four runtimes builds this backend's `Embedder`.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Runtime {
    Candle,
    Ollama,
    #[serde(rename = "openai")]
    OpenAi,
    #[default]
    Hash,
}
```

### struct `EmbeddingBackendManifest`

A backend definition, as stored. The id is the filename, so it cannot drift from what the file is called.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
pub struct EmbeddingBackendManifest {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "String::is_empty")]
    pub label: String,
    pub runtime: Runtime,
    pub model: String,
    pub dimensions: u32,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub base_url: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub api_key_env: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub fallbacks: Vec<String>,
    pub created_at: u64,
    pub updated_at: u64,
}
```


### struct `FailoverEmbedder`

The `Embedder` a resolved chain hands back: tries each member in order on every call and returns the first success, so a runtime failure (an unreachable ollama, a dropped connection to a hosted endpoint) fails over per call, not only at start-up.

```rust
#[derive(Debug)]
struct FailoverEmbedder {
    model: String,
    dimensions: u32,
    chain: Vec<Arc<dyn Embedder>>,
}
```

## `src/error.rs`

### type `Result`

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

### enum `Error`

```rust
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("embedding store error: {0}")]
    Config(adi_config::Error),
    #[error( "invalid embedding backend name {0:?}: {rule}", rule = adi_config::NAME_RULE )]
    InvalidName(String),
    #[error("invalid embedding backend: {0}")]
    Arguments(String),
    #[error("no such embedding backend: {0}")]
    NotFound(String),
    #[error("no embedding backend is assigned to {0:?}")]
    Unassigned(String),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Embed(adi_indexer::embed::EmbedError),
    #[error("embedding store I/O error: {0}")]
    Io(std::io::Error),
}
```
